code_comments.body:
I think is a bad design.

Either:
 - This should be removed and callers should use ``GetSecretValue`` from ``secrets/secret.go`` with ``tls.crt`` and ``tls.key`` as key. Then verify the secret contained both themselves.

Or:
- This function should not return the secret, but instead both data values directly as in ``return secret.Data["tls.crt"], secret.Data["tls.key"], nil``

code_comments.body: According to the planwerk spec, the point of this is privilege separation so I think a user is always supposed to be authorized to work on one database not ALL databases.
code_comments.author: gndrmnn

code_comments.body: I don't think we should do this. Instead the update should fail if the new ClusterIP is different from the old one. Otherwise, the EnsureService will run without error, but the new configuration might not be applied as specified.
code_comments.author: gndrmnn

code_comments.body: Reverse the order: First try to create the resource, if ``IsAlreadyExists`` then fetch and return existing. Prevent doing the same thing twice.
code_comments.author: gndrmnn

code_comments.body: As discussed in a previous comment, I think it would make more sense to first attempt to create the resource and then retrieve it, if creation fails with ``IsAlreadyExists``
